calibration.method: Platt logistic on independent calibration split

unmanned.rule: Lowest validation threshold with zero validation false-positive rows (precision-first, unattended hours)

standard.rule: Frozen v1.0 rule: maximum validation F1 subject to validation FPR <= 1%

screening.rule: Highest validation threshold keeping validation row recall >= 0.85 (recall-first inspection candidate list)

scope: Dataset state classification; not validated failure probability or pre-failure lead time
input_units: Source units unknown; site mapping and baseline confirmation required
